name: obsidian-relay
description: Self-hosted Obsidian assistant that answers from your vault even when your PC is off

scripts.build: npm run build -w @relay/core && npm run build -w @relay/server && npm run build -w @relay/app
scripts.test: npm run test -w @relay/core && npm run test -w @relay/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @relay/core && npm run typecheck -w @relay/server && npm run typecheck -w @relay/app
